posts.title: 🎨 November 2, 2026
posts.description: I'm not at my best in crowds. It's just so stressful. Especially at concerts, where some people seem to forget that they exist in space and time and are nothing but a nuisance. It would be great to be a more forgiving person who can just overlook those people and enjoy the moment, and I'm getting better at that, but it's not easy. Unfortunately, in situations like these, I'm also not the best comp

posts.title: 🎨 November 1, 2026
posts.description: I promise we had more social interactions with the other guests as well. But this comic reminded me of what parties were like in my early twenties, when social media was new and we all sent dozens of tweets with party updates throughout the night. Weird times. But I met most of my friends back then, so that era actually deserves the "social" in social media.

posts.title: GTA VI, day 2
posts.description: Replying to GTA 6 Impressions I can’t get enough of this game. The story picked up quite a bit, and I’m thoroughly invested in it. Can’t wait to see where this is going. I robbed my first convenience store today. The clerk had a panic attack, I couldn’t find his vape fast enough, and he died. F in chat.
